Commentary.Commentary: England Women (Unchanged XI) - Danni Wyatt, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey, Natalie Sciver (C), Amy Jones (WK), Maia Bouchier, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Freya Kemp, Issy Wong and Sarah Glenn.

New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Sophie Devine (C), Suzie Bates, Amelia Kerr, Maddy Green, Brooke Halliday, Hayley Jensen, Izzy Gaze (WK), Lea Tahuhu, Hannah Rowe, Rosemary Mair and Fran Jonas (In place of Eden Carson).
TOSS - New Zealand Women have won the toss and they will have a BAT first.

For New Zealand, this has been a much better tournament than the previous T20 World Cup. They seem to be a dominant side and would be aiming to head back home with a medal. This is the toughest competition until now for the White Ferns in the group stage. It gives them a nice opportunity to gear up for the next round. Which team will walk back with the bragging rights? We shall find out soon, as the toss is not far away.
